children: Qnity Electronics established a $43 million indemnification liability representing its 44% share of DuPont's after-tax liability for the North Carolina PFAS settlement.
Company recorded a $43.0M indemnification liability in Q2 2026 tied to the DuPont settlement.
Liability equals Qnity's Applicable Percentage of 44% of DuPont's after-tax exposure and remains unchanged.
DuPont, Chemours and Corteva will treat settlements against the 2021 MOU limit as 25-year equal installments discounted at 8% NPV.
Future MOU escrow contributions may be satisfied by payments from settlements with New Jersey and North Carolina, including the Sept 2026 escrow obligation.
